title: Production Engineer
description:
As a Production Engineer, you will play a key role within our Test Engineering team, programming test software and documenting test procedures to scale production of our next-generation drone platforms. In this position, you will take ownership of verification and production test equipment, from defining test concepts to designing automated test solutions, jigs and needle-bed adapters that help us improve yield and reliability. You’ll collaborate closely with our software and electronics engineers and OEM partners to enhance test coverage and reduce testing time, driving efficiency across our manufacturing process.

This is a hands-on role in a fast-paced, agile environment, offering the opportunity to design creative, practical test solutions from concept through to mass production. This involves balancing the transition from our existing test setups to more scalable and complete solutions in a pragmatic and iterative way for a number of different projects.

Beyond test engineering, you’ll apply your software expertise across the broader hardware and software team by supporting the engineering validation efforts of new products. You will also visit OEMs to support new product integrations and support small scale engineering runs in person.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Research, design and build test solutions, including auto generated, 3D printed test equipment and CNC milled custom test jigs, and needle-bed adapters to enable low-volume prototyping and mid- to high-volume PCB production.
  • Plan and execute product verification, covering test case definition, execution, analysis, and comprehensive documentation, also for repair guidance.
  • Write Python code and STM32 firmware to test our embedded products from the inside (selftest) and outside (via test fixture).
  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams by offering technical guidance and hands-on support for testing and validati…

title: Electronics Engineering Intern
description:
We are looking for an enthusiastic Electronics Engineering Intern to gain hands-on experience designing, building, testing, and debugging electronic hardware. Working alongside senior engineers, you’ll contribute across the development cycle—from schematic and PCB design through prototyping, testing, debugging, and documentation.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Build, assemble, test, and debug prototype circuits and PCB assemblies.
  • Assist with schematic capture and PCB design.
  • Use lab equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and signal generators for testing and troubleshooting.
  • Support soldering, rework, and other hands-on laboratory activities.
  • Develop and test firmware for microcontrollers and embedded systems.
  • Analyse test results and document designs, tests, and project progress.
  • Work with senior engineers to troubleshoot technical issues and improve hardware performance.
  • Follow engineering and laboratory safety procedures.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Currently pursuing a Master’s degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or a related field.
  • Understanding of analog and digital circuit design.
  • Familiarity with PCB design tools such as Altium, KiCad, or Eagle.
  • Hands-on experience with electronics lab equipment and basic soldering.
  • Programming experience in C, C++, Python, or similar.
  • Familiarity with STM32, ESP32, Arduino, or other microcontrollers.
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as I²C, SPI, UART, CAN, or USB is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and teamwork skills.
  • Hands-on experience through university, robotics, or personal electronics projects is highly valued.
  • EU citizenship required. 

Benefits

  • Flexible working hours
  • Generous holiday…

title: Electronics Engineer
description:
As an Electronics Engineer, you will be a member of our interdisciplinary hardware engineering team, contributing to the design and development of electronics for our next-generation drone platforms. You’ll work on electronic modules such as flight controllers, sensors, and vision systems, supporting PCB development from concept through production.

As part of a cross-functional team, you will contribute to advanced systems such as interceptor and reconnaissance drones with integrated visual navigation, as well as quadcopters for defense applications.

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Design, prototype, and validate avionics PCBs, sensors, and electronic modules for drone platforms, contributing to designs from initial concepts through detailed design and manufacturing
  • Support PCB and product verification activities, including test planning, execution, and documentation; contribute to electrical and mechanical validation such as EMI/EMC compliance testing, thermal cycling, and mechanical shock testing
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including design concepts, schematics and CAD drawings, bills of materials (BOMs), assembly instructions, and repair documentation
  • Collaborate with test engineering, manufacturing, and production teams to support the transition of hardware designs from development to production
  • Work with hardware and software engineers to define electronics requirements, system interfaces, and design solutions
  • Support troubleshooting and design improvements based on test results, production feedback, and field performance
  • Contribute to the development and improvement of engineering processes and best practices within the hardware team

Qualifications and Skills

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical or Electronics Engineering
  • 2+ years of experience in PCB design and electronic product dev…

title: Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d)
description:
Kurz und knapp

Du hast dein Studium in der Tasche, sprühst vor Energie und willst nicht nur zuschauen, sondern echte Verantwortung übernehmen?

Bei Picnic startest du direkt in einer Führungsrolle durch! Als Graduate Operations Supervisor (m/w/d) in unserem teilautomatisierten Fulfillment Center (FC) in Falkensee bist du der Motor des Standorts. Unterstützt von Investoren wie der Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation bauen wir gemeinsam das modernste, 100 % elektrische Liefersystem Europas.

Sei von Anfang an dabei: Im August 2027 eröffnen wir unser neues teilautomatisiertes Fulfillment Center in Falkensee. Du kannst aber schon früher bei uns starten und dein Onboarding an einem unserer bestehenden Standorte absolvieren - zum Beispiel in unserem manuellen Fulfillment Center in Ludwigsfelde oder unserem vollautomatisierten Fulfillment Center in Oberhausen. So bekommst du einen umfassenden Einblick in unsere Operations und bist bestens vorbereitet, wenn wir in Falkensee an den Start gehen.

Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Du bist Coach und Vorbild – mit deinem echten, intrinsischen Interesse an Menschen führst und inspirierst du dein Team aus 5 Lead Shoppers und über 150 Shoppers.
  • Schichtleitung: Im FC behältst du stets den Überblick, priorisierst Aufgaben im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass jede Bestellung pünktlich rausgeht.
  • Abwechslung: Du erlebst den perfekten Mix aus Action direkt auf der Lagerfläche (4 Tage pro Woche) und strategischem Deep Dive im FC Office (1 Tag pro Woche).
  • Prozessoptimierung: Stillstand gibt es bei uns nicht. Du hast Ideen? Hier entwickelst du eigene Logistikprojekte und hebst unsere Abläufe durch deinen Tatendrang…
